name: drop-required
description: Three claims the pipeline must keep and three it must discard. The stub emits all six as well-formed model output, so 'write whatever the model said' keeps its recall and loses drop compliance.
note: It also carries one claim the pipeline KEEPS and should not have: 'Someone Unheard Of' is not a reject, because the shipped resolver degrades to the slugify floor (facts-extract.ts:517) and mints a someone-unheard-of ledger row. That is a precision failure, not a drop failure, and it is here so fidelityPrecision has something to be less than 1 about. The three real rejects each name a gate that actually fires: an echoed diarizer label (r0), an explicit null entity (r1), and an entity with no slug-alphabet character at all (r2, an em dash the model used where it meant null).
